# 📖 Description
Sulfuric Brewing is a Vanilla+ datapack that introduces a brand-new alchemical mechanic to Minecraft. By throwing any splash or lingering potion at a sulfur speleothem, the stalactite will absorb the mixture, causing it to temporarily drip that specific potion effect into cauldrons or onto entities below. Perfect for automating potion production or creating clever survival traps!
